S. 5, Special Branch
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 1440/OC(3)
Date May 4, 23 1940.
Time 5 40

Subject (in full) Lists of publications seized, closed, suspended or warned
by S.M. Police between January 1 and May 2, 1940.

Made by D.S. Pharazyn Forwarded by Supt. Mason

Forwarded herewith is a set of lists of
publications which were seized, closed, suspended or
warned by the Shanghai Municipal Police between January
1 and May 2, 1940, for publishing anti-Japanese or
other objectionable matter.

Copies of the books entitled "The Second
European War Digest" (論第二次世界大戰), "Life or Death
Place" (生死場), "Wen Ni Cheng Ti" (文藝陣地) and
"Armoured Trains" (鐵甲列車) mentioned in the list of
seizures are attached herewith, copies of the remaining
ones having been burned early in April this year on
instructions of D.S.I. Golder.

D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

主题（全称） 1940年1月1日至5月2日期间由上海公共租界工部局警务处查扣、查封、停刊或警告的出版物清单。

编制人：副督察 Pharazyn 转呈人：警司 Mason

现随函附上1940年1月1日至5月2日期间，上海公共租界工部局警务处因刊登反日或其他不良内容而查扣、查封、停刊或警告的出版物清单一套。

查扣清单中提及的题为《论第二次世界大战》（The Second European War Digest）、《生死场》（Life or Death Place）、《文艺阵地》（Wen Ni Cheng Ti）和《铁甲列车》（Armoured Trains）的书籍副本随函附上，其余书籍的副本已根据副总巡 Golder 的指示于今年4月初焚毁。

副督察

分区助理总监（特务科）。
